name: learning-loop
description: A self-improvement loop for your agent: corrections and diagnosed failures become durable, deduplicated, evidence-counted lessons in .ai/memory/LESSONS.md, then surface in later sessions so the same mistakes stop recurring. Standalone lessons-only alternative to session-memory, with a bundled SessionStart hook that surfaces the lesson count automatically. Do not install both packages because they route the same lesson workflow and both hook the lesson ledger.
